nodes.name: Plan Review & Approval
nodes.goal: Present full execution plan for one-time human approval before autonomous execution.

nodes.name: Project Scaffolding & Tooling
nodes.goal: Initialize Spring Boot Maven backend, Vite React TypeScript frontend with pnpm, PostgreSQL config, and shared lint/format tooling.

nodes.name: Database Schema & JPA Entities
nodes.goal: Define PostgreSQL schema and JPA entities for User, Team, TeamMember, Task, Comment, ActivityLog with migrations.

nodes.name: Backend Health Endpoint
nodes.goal: Implement /api/health endpoint and basic actuator configuration.

nodes.name: Authentication & JWT Security
nodes.goal: Implement registration, login, password hashing (BCrypt), JWT issuance/validation, and Spring Security filter chain protecting APIs.

nodes.name: RBAC & User Profile
nodes.goal: Implement ADMIN/MANAGER/MEMBER roles, method-level authorization, and authenticated /users/me profile endpoint.

nodes.name: Team Management & Membership
nodes.goal: Implement team CRUD, member invitation/addition/removal, and team membership authorization.

nodes.name: Task CRUD & Statuses
nodes.goal: Implement task create/read/update/delete with title, description, priority, due date, and TODO/IN_PROGRESS/DONE statuses protected by auth.

nodes.name: Task Assignment, Reassignment & Workload
nodes.goal: Enable assigning/reassigning tasks to team members, filtering by assignee, unassigned tasks view, and workload metrics endpoint.

nodes.name: Task Comments
nodes.goal: Implement comment creation, listing, edit/delete by author, with author and timestamp metadata.

nodes.name: Activity Audit Log
nodes.goal: Capture and expose activity events for task creation, status, priority, due date, assignee changes, and comment create/delete.

nodes.name: Dashboard & Analytics APIs
nodes.goal: Provide global and team-level dashboards with task counts by status and aggregates.

nodes.name: Frontend Auth Shell & Routing
nodes.goal: Build login/register screens, JWT storage, axios interceptors, protected routes, and global layout.

nodes.name: Frontend Task Board & Detail
nodes.goal: Implement responsive task board, create/edit modal, task detail drawer with comments and activity timeline, filters by assignee and unassigned.

nodes.name: Frontend Teams, Workload & Dashboard
nodes.goal: Implement teams list, team detail with member management and workload, global dashboard, and profile screen.

nodes.name: Automated Testing
nodes.goal: Add backend unit/integration tests (JUnit, Spring Boot Test) and frontend tests (Vitest/RTL) covering auth, RBAC, tasks, comments, audit.

nodes.name: Packaging, Docker & Deployment Readiness
nodes.goal: Containerize backend and frontend, provide docker-compose with PostgreSQL, environment configs, and README runbook.
